-- Statement ledger for MathEconLib. Generated file: do not edit by hand.
-- Regenerate from the repository root with
--   lake build MathEconLib && lake exe statement_ledger
-- CI fails when this file is out of date (scripts/check-statement-ledger.sh).
--
-- Scope: the declarations of the `MathEconLib.*` modules selected by the filter of the Mathlib
-- pull-request declaration summaries (leanprover-community/mathlib-ci,
-- scripts/pr_summary/dumpReasonableDecls.lean): not private, not unsafe, and not
-- `Lean.Name.isInternalDetail` (no name component starting with `_` or numeric, and no last
-- component `eq_<n>`, `match_<n>`, `proof_<n>`, or `omega_<n>`). Compiler-generated declarations
-- that pass this filter (recursors, constructors, projections, `casesOn`, `noConfusion`,
-- `injEq`, ...) are listed too. Equation lemmas such as `f.eq_def` are listed only if the library
-- itself caused them to be generated.
--
-- One entry per declaration, sorted by full name:
--   * theorem, axiom, opaque, instance, constructor, recursor, projection: the signature;
--   * def, abbrev: the signature, then the equation lemmas Lean generates for it (`eq_<n>`, or
--     `eq_def` when there are none), not the compiled body;
--   * generated def (auxiliary recursors, `noConfusion`, `ctorIdx`, ...): the signature;
--   * structure, class: the signature, the constructor, the parent projections, and each field
--     (inherited fields included) with its type and default value;
--   * inductive: the signature and each constructor.
-- The last line of an entry is a 64-bit FNV-1a hash of its statement expressions (signature,
-- equations, fields, constructors), computed on the expressions themselves with metadata
-- dropped, proof subterms erased, and hygiene erased from binder names. It changes when a
-- statement changes even if the printed form does not.
--
-- Printing options are fixed: proofs elided as `⋯`, notation and coercions shown, universe
-- parameters listed after the declaration name (universe arguments inside terms are covered by
-- the hash), full names, no truncation, width 100. Hygienic and shadowing binder names are
-- renamed (`x✝` to `x`, a repeated `x` to `x_1`); anonymous instance binders print as `[C]`.

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.affiliated_iff_logSupermodular {n : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ}
  (hf : ∀ (x : Fin n → ℝ), 0 < f x) :
  MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.Affiliated f ↔
    ∀ (x y : Fin n → ℝ),
      Real.log (f x) + Real.log (f y) ≤ Real.log (f (x ⊔ y)) + Real.log (f (x ⊓ y))

  x ∈ MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.winningSlice S i t ↔
    (x ∈ S ∧ x i = t) ∧ ∀ (j : Fin n), x j ≤ t
  -- hash ffdafb6ef55c1230

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.monotoneOn_condExpSlice_of_affiliated {n : ℕ}
  {f g : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ} {S : Finset (Fin n → ℝ)}
  (hf : MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.Affiliated f) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < f x)
  (hsub : IsSublattice ↑S) (hg : Monotone g) (i : Fin n) :
  MonotoneOn (MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.condExpSlice f g S i) ↑(Finset.image (fun x ↦ x i) S)
  -- hash 505e0c29acafbe82

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.mul_sup_inf_eq (h : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
  h (Max.max a b) * h (Min.min a b) = h a * h b
  -- hash cfa6c0363e29517d

  (t : ℝ) : Finset (Fin n → ℝ)
  eq_1 {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n → ℝ)) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.ownSignalSlice S i t = {x ∈ S | x i = t}

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.sum_mul_sum_le_of_affiliated {n : ℕ} {f g : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ}
  {S A B : Finset (Fin n → ℝ)} (hf : MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.Affiliated f)
  (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < f x) (hsub : IsSublattice ↑S) (hg : Monotone g) (hg0 : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ g x)
  (hAS : A ⊆ S) (hBS : B ⊆ S) (hsupAB : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, a ⊔ b ∈ B)
  (hinfAB : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, a ⊓ b ∈ A) :
  (∑ x ∈ A, g x * f x) * ∑ x ∈ B, f x ≤ (∑ x ∈ B, g x * f x) * ∑ x ∈ A, f x
  -- hash 447ececb5c488f37

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.sum_mul_sum_le_winningSlice_of_affiliated {n : ℕ}
  {f g : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ} {S : Finset (Fin n → ℝ)}
  (hf : MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.Affiliated f) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < f x)
  (hsub : IsSublattice ↑S) (hg : Monotone g) (hg0 : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ g x) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
  (∑ x ∈ MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.winningSlice S i t, g x * f x) *
      ∑ x ∈ MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.ownSignalSlice S i t, f x ≤
    (∑ x ∈ MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.ownSignalSlice S i t, g x * f x) *
      ∑ x ∈ MathEconLib.Auction.Affiliation.winningSlice S i t, f x
  -- hash 645670cdcbf9814d

def MathEconLib.Auction.ExAnteIR {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n) : Prop
  eq_1 {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n) :
    A.ExAnteIR =
      ∀ (i : Fin n),
        0 ≤
          ∫ (a : Ω),
            (fun ω ↦
                A.θ i ω * A.rules.outcome (fun x ↦ A.θ x ω) i + A.rules.transfer i fun x ↦ A.θ x ω)
              a
  -- hash 3c28efb0cf3ed5be

def MathEconLib.Auction.ExPostIR {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n) : Prop
  eq_1 {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n) :
    A.ExPostIR =
      ∀ (i : Fin n) (θ : Fin n → ℝ),
        (∀ (j : Fin n), θ j ∈ A.interval j) → 0 ≤ θ i * A.rules.outcome θ i + A.rules.transfer i θ
  -- hash bc83db4bcc8b32b3

def MathEconLib.Auction.allPayBid {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n) [A.HasIdenticalTypes] (v : ℝ) : ℝ
  eq_1 {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n) [A.HasIdenticalTypes] (v : ℝ) :
    A.allPayBid v =
      v * A.commonCDF v ^ (n - 1) - ∫ (t : ℝ) in A.lowestType..v, A.commonCDF t ^ (n - 1)
  -- hash c908b25b7cbd12ab

def MathEconLib.Auction.allPurchaseNetCost {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n)
  (spec : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.AllPurchaseSpec A.rules fun o i ↦ o i) (β : ℝ → ℝ)
  (i : Fin n) (b : ℝ) : ℝ
  eq_1 {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n)
    (spec : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.AllPurchaseSpec A.rules fun o i ↦ o i) (β : ℝ → ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (b : ℝ) :
    A.allPurchaseNetCost spec β i b =
      spec.price * b -
        b * ∫ (a : Ω), (fun ω ↦ spec.φ (b + ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, β (A.θ j ω))) a
  -- hash 61759df3ddb1fc53

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.bundling_revenue_gain {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n)
  (spec : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.AllPurchaseSpec A.rules fun o i ↦ o i)
  [A.HasIdenticalTypes] [A.HasIndependentTypes] [A.HasBoundedTypes] [A.HasAtomlessTypes] (β : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hβ_meas : Measurable β) (hβ_mono : StrictMonoOn β (Set.Icc A.lowestType A.highestType))
  (hIC : ∀ (i : Fin n), (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).HasTypeDeviationIC)
  (ht_int :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.rules.payment i fun j ↦ β (A.θ j ω))
        MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hedition_int :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.aggregateBid β ω * spec.φ (A.aggregateBid β ω))
      MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hallPayBid_meas : Measurable A.allPayBid)
  (hallPayBid_int :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.allPayBid (A.θ i ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hU_sym :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).U (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).lowestType = A.lowestTypeUtility ⋯ β)
  (hU0 : A.lowestTypeUtility ⋯ β = 0) (c B_ed : ℝ) :
  A.bundledProfit spec β c - A.allPayBenchmarkProfit - A.editionsOnlyBenchmarkProfit spec c B_ed =
    A.expectedEditionValue spec β - c * A.expectedAggregateBid β - (spec.price - c) * B_ed
  -- hash 067df7063c198504

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.mk.inj {Ω : Type} {inst : MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω}
  {inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume} {n : ℕ}
  {rules : MathEconLib.Mechanism (Fin n) (fun x ↦ ℝ) (Fin n → ℝ)}
  {outcome_measurable : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable fun bids ↦ rules.outcome bids i}
  {θmin θmax : Fin n → ℝ} {θ : Fin n → Ω → ℝ} {θ_measurable : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (θ i)}
  {rules_1 : MathEconLib.Mechanism (Fin n) (fun x ↦ ℝ) (Fin n → ℝ)}
  {outcome_measurable_1 : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable fun bids ↦ rules_1.outcome bids i}
  {θmin_1 θmax_1 : Fin n → ℝ} {θ_1 : Fin n → Ω → ℝ}
  {θ_measurable_1 : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (θ_1 i)}
  (x :
    { rules := rules, outcome_measurable := outcome_measurable, θmin := θmin, θmax := θmax, θ := θ,
        θ_measurable := θ_measurable } =
      { rules := rules_1, outcome_measurable := outcome_measurable_1, θmin := θmin_1,
        θmax := θmax_1, θ := θ_1, θ_measurable := θ_measurable_1 }) :
  rules = rules_1 ∧ θmin = θmin_1 ∧ θmax = θmax_1 ∧ θ = θ_1
  -- hash de0329bc399f700e

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.mk.injEq {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (rules : MathEconLib.Mechanism (Fin n) (fun x ↦ ℝ) (Fin n → ℝ))
  (outcome_measurable : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable fun bids ↦ rules.outcome bids i)
  (θmin θmax : Fin n → ℝ) (θ : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (θ_measurable : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (θ i))
  (rules_1 : MathEconLib.Mechanism (Fin n) (fun x ↦ ℝ) (Fin n → ℝ))
  (outcome_measurable_1 : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable fun bids ↦ rules_1.outcome bids i)
  (θmin_1 θmax_1 : Fin n → ℝ) (θ_1 : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
  (θ_measurable_1 : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (θ_1 i)) :
  ({ rules := rules, outcome_measurable := outcome_measurable, θmin := θmin, θmax := θmax, θ := θ,
        θ_measurable := θ_measurable } =
      { rules := rules_1, outcome_measurable := outcome_measurable_1, θmin := θmin_1,
        θmax := θmax_1, θ := θ_1, θ_measurable := θ_measurable_1 }) =
    (rules = rules_1 ∧ θmin = θmin_1 ∧ θmax = θmax_1 ∧ θ = θ_1)
  -- hash 69263800783df807

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.mk.sizeOf_spec {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [SizeOf Ω]
  (rules : MathEconLib.Mechanism (Fin n) (fun x ↦ ℝ) (Fin n → ℝ))
  (outcome_measurable : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable fun bids ↦ rules.outcome bids i)
  (θmin θmax : Fin n → ℝ) (θ : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (θ_measurable : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (θ i)) :
  SizeOf.sizeOf
      { rules := rules, outcome_measurable := outcome_measurable, θmin := θmin, θmax := θmax,
        θ := θ, θ_measurable := θ_measurable } =
    1 + SizeOf.sizeOf rules

  (hq : A.q i = A₂.q j) (hU : A.U i (A.θmin i) = A₂.U j (A₂.θmin j)) {s : ℝ}

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.payment_formula {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n)
  (halloc : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.IsUnitIntervalAllocation A.rules fun o i ↦ o i) [A.BIC]
  (i : Fin n) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ A.interval i) :
  A.p i s = s * A.q i s - A.U i (A.θmin i) - ∫ (ψ : ℝ) in A.θmin i..s, A.q i ψ
  -- hash ea3f521f311903f8

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.payment_formula_strictHighestBid {Ω : Type}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [n.AtLeastTwo]
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n) [A.IsSymmetricIPV]

  [A.BIC] [A.HasZeroLowestTypeUtility] (i : Fin n) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ A.interval i) :
  A.p i s = s * A.commonCDF s ^ (n - 1) - ∫ (ψ : ℝ) in A.lowestType..s, A.commonCDF ψ ^ (n - 1)

  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n) [A.HasIndependentTypes] [A.HasIdenticalTypes] [A.HasBoundedTypes]

  (i : Fin n) (b : ℝ) :
  A.q_strat σ i b = A.commonCDF (MathEconLib.bidThreshold σ A.lowestType A.highestType b) ^ (n - 1)

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.revenue_decomposition {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n)
  (spec : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.AllPurchaseSpec A.rules fun o i ↦ o i)
  [A.HasIdenticalTypes] [A.HasIndependentTypes] [A.HasBoundedTypes] [A.HasAtomlessTypes] (β : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hβ_meas : Measurable β) (hβ_mono : StrictMonoOn β (Set.Icc A.lowestType A.highestType))
  (hIC : ∀ (i : Fin n), (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).HasTypeDeviationIC)
  (ht_int :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.rules.payment i fun j ↦ β (A.θ j ω))
        MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hedition_int :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.aggregateBid β ω * spec.φ (A.aggregateBid β ω))
      MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hallPayBid_meas : Measurable A.allPayBid)
  (hallPayBid_int :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.allPayBid (A.θ i ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hU_sym :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).U (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).lowestType = A.lowestTypeUtility ⋯ β) :
  A.sellerGrossRevenue spec β =
    ↑n * A.expectedAllPayBid - ↑n * A.lowestTypeUtility ⋯ β + A.expectedEditionValue spec β
  -- hash 21163bdb5ba87444

theorem MathEconLib.Auction.revenue_decomposition_boundary {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n)
  (spec : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.AllPurchaseSpec A.rules fun o i ↦ o i)

  (hβ_meas : Measurable β) (hβ_mono : StrictMonoOn β (Set.Icc A.lowestType A.highestType))
  (hIC : ∀ (i : Fin n), (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).HasTypeDeviationIC)
  (ht_int :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.rules.payment i fun j ↦ β (A.θ j ω))
        MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hedition_int :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.aggregateBid β ω * spec.φ (A.aggregateBid β ω))
      MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hallPayBid_meas : Measurable A.allPayBid)
  (hallPayBid_int :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.allPayBid (A.θ i ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hU_sym :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).U (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).lowestType = A.lowestTypeUtility ⋯ β)
  (hU0 : A.lowestTypeUtility ⋯ β = 0) :
  A.sellerGrossRevenue spec β = ↑n * A.expectedAllPayBid + A.expectedEditionValue spec β
  -- hash 31d190d9268b77aa

  (hq : ∀ (i : Fin n), A.q i = A₂.q i) (hmin : A.lowestType = A₂.lowestType)
  (hmax : A.highestType = A₂.highestType)
  (ident :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (A.θ i) (A₂.θ i) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume
        MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  [A.BIC] [A₂.BIC] [A.HasZeroLowestTypeUtility] [A₂.HasZeroLowestTypeUtility]
  (p_meas : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (A₂.p i))
  (hint₁ :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.p i (A.θ i ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hint₂ :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A₂.p i (A₂.θ i ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume) :
  A.expectedRevenue = A₂.expectedRevenue

def MathEconLib.Auction.toBidderProblem {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n)
  (halloc : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.IsUnitIntervalAllocation A.rules fun o i ↦ o i)
  (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : MathEconLib.BidderProblem
  eq_1 {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n)
    (halloc : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.IsUnitIntervalAllocation A.rules fun o i ↦ o i)
    (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    A.toBidderProblem halloc σ i =
      { lowestType := A.θmin i, highestType := A.θmax i, winProb := A.q_strat σ i,
        winProb_range := ⋯, cost := A.p_strat σ i, strategy := σ }
  -- hash e786a2ae3a99a8a8

theorem MathEconLib.BidderProblem.mk.congr_simp (lowestType lowestType_1 : ℝ)
  (e_lowestType : lowestType = lowestType_1) (highestType highestType_1 : ℝ)
  (e_highestType : highestType = highestType_1) (winProb winProb_1 : ℝ → ℝ)
  (e_winProb : winProb = winProb_1) (winProb_range : ∀ (x : ℝ), winProb x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
  (cost cost_1 : ℝ → ℝ) (e_cost : cost = cost_1) (strategy strategy_1 : ℝ → ℝ)
  (e_strategy : strategy = strategy_1) :
  { lowestType := lowestType, highestType := highestType, winProb := winProb,
      winProb_range := winProb_range, cost := cost, strategy := strategy } =
    { lowestType := lowestType_1, highestType := highestType_1, winProb := winProb_1,
      winProb_range := ⋯, cost := cost_1, strategy := strategy_1 }
  -- hash 0fc152252d01e5f6

theorem MathEconLib.BidderProblem.mk.inj {lowestType highestType : ℝ} {winProb : ℝ → ℝ}
  {winProb_range : ∀ (x : ℝ), winProb x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1} {cost strategy : ℝ → ℝ}
  {lowestType_1 highestType_1 : ℝ} {winProb_1 : ℝ → ℝ}
  {winProb_range_1 : ∀ (x : ℝ), winProb_1 x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1} {cost_1 strategy_1 : ℝ → ℝ}
  (x :
    { lowestType := lowestType, highestType := highestType, winProb := winProb,
        winProb_range := winProb_range, cost := cost, strategy := strategy } =
      { lowestType := lowestType_1, highestType := highestType_1, winProb := winProb_1,
        winProb_range := winProb_range_1, cost := cost_1, strategy := strategy_1 }) :
  lowestType = lowestType_1 ∧
    highestType = highestType_1 ∧ winProb = winProb_1 ∧ cost = cost_1 ∧ strategy = strategy_1
  -- hash 99e469b41bb49581

theorem MathEconLib.BidderProblem.mk.injEq (lowestType highestType : ℝ) (winProb : ℝ → ℝ)
  (winProb_range : ∀ (x : ℝ), winProb x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (cost strategy : ℝ → ℝ)
  (lowestType_1 highestType_1 : ℝ) (winProb_1 : ℝ → ℝ)
  (winProb_range_1 : ∀ (x : ℝ), winProb_1 x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (cost_1 strategy_1 : ℝ → ℝ) :
  ({ lowestType := lowestType, highestType := highestType, winProb := winProb,
        winProb_range := winProb_range, cost := cost, strategy := strategy } =
      { lowestType := lowestType_1, highestType := highestType_1, winProb := winProb_1,
        winProb_range := winProb_range_1, cost := cost_1, strategy := strategy_1 }) =
    (lowestType = lowestType_1 ∧
      highestType = highestType_1 ∧ winProb = winProb_1 ∧ cost = cost_1 ∧ strategy = strategy_1)

theorem MathEconLib.BidderProblem.mk.sizeOf_spec (lowestType highestType : ℝ) (winProb : ℝ → ℝ)
  (winProb_range : ∀ (x : ℝ), winProb x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (cost strategy : ℝ → ℝ) :
  SizeOf.sizeOf
      { lowestType := lowestType, highestType := highestType, winProb := winProb,
        winProb_range := winProb_range, cost := cost, strategy := strategy } =

def MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction.BilaterallySubstitutable.{u_1, u_2} {A : Type u_1}
  {X : Type u_2} (counterparty : X → A) (C : MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X) : Prop
  eq_1 {A : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} (counterparty : X → A)
    (C : MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X) :
    MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction.BilaterallySubstitutable counterparty C =
      ∀ ⦃x z : X⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄,
        MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction.Fresh counterparty x Y →
          MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction.Fresh counterparty z Y →
            x ∉ C (Insert.insert x Y) → x ∉ C (Insert.insert x (Insert.insert z Y))
  -- hash eac02b0fed16f83a

def MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction.UnilaterallySubstitutable.{u_1, u_2} {A : Type u_1}
  {X : Type u_2} (counterparty : X → A) (C : MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X) : Prop
  eq_1 {A : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} (counterparty : X → A)
    (C : MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X) :

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.HasIntegrableInterimDeviations.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
  {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [DecidableEq I]
  [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
  (B : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianPrior.ConditionalBeliefs μ) [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  (s : G.Strategy) : Prop
  eq_1 {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [DecidableEq I]
    [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]
    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
    (B : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianPrior.ConditionalBeliefs μ) [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    (s : G.Strategy) :
    G.HasIntegrableInterimDeviations μ B s =
      ∀ (i : I),
        ∀ᵐ (θᵢ : Θ i) ∂MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianPrior.marginalType μ i,
          ∀ (aᵢ : A i),
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (G.interimPayoffActionIntegrand i θᵢ aᵢ s) ((B.opponents i) θᵢ)
  -- hash 10da34a3b3c9402e

  [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)] [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
  (s : G.Strategy) : Prop
  eq_1 {I : Type uI} {Θ : I → Type uT} {A : I → Type uA} {V : Type uV}

    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
    (s : G.Strategy) :
    G.IncumbentPayoffsIntegrable μ s =
      ∀ (i : I), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun θ ↦ G.payoff i (G.measurableActionProfile s θ) θ) μ
  -- hash 91e3921c88041efd

    [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]

  -- hash c1eda8a7e9f18ac7

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.bnePredFin.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {I : Type u_1}
  {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V] [Fintype I]
  [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) :
  MathEconLib.GameTheory.EquilibriumProblem G.PureStrategy ((i : I) × Θ i) V
  eq_1 {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V]
    [Module ℝ V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
    (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) :
    G.bnePredFin d =
      { deviation := fun p s s' ↦ ∀ (j : I) (θ_j : Θ j), ⟨j, θ_j⟩ ≠ p → s' j θ_j = s j θ_j,
        value := fun p s ↦ G.interimPayoffActionFin d p.fst p.snd (s p.fst p.snd) s }
  -- hash 6b8b126f6a0b53d4

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.bnePredFin_deviation_iff.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
  {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V]

  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) (p : (i : I) × Θ i)
  (s s' : G.PureStrategy) :
  (G.bnePredFin d).deviation p s s' ↔ ∀ (j : I) (θ_j : Θ j), ⟨j, θ_j⟩ ≠ p → s' j θ_j = s j θ_j
  -- hash 6ef773eabf2be5f6

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.bneProblem.{uI, uT, uA, uV} {I : Type uI} {Θ : I → Type uT}
  {A : I → Type uA} {V : Type uV} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V]
  [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i)) :
  MathEconLib.GameTheory.EquilibriumProblem G.Strategy I V
  eq_1 {I : Type uI} {Θ : I → Type uT} {A : I → Type uA} {V : Type uV} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)]
    [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)] (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
    (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i)) :
    G.bneProblem μ =
      {
        deviation := fun i s s' ↦
          (∀ (j : I), j ≠ i → s' j = s j) ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun θ ↦ G.payoff i (G.measurableActionProfile s' θ) θ) μ,
        value := fun i s ↦ G.exAntePayoff μ i s }
  -- hash ab4febcd70ce2999

  {Θ : I → Type uT} {A : I → Type uA} {V : Type uV} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
  [CompleteSpace V] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
  (i : I) (s s' : G.Strategy) :
  (G.bneProblem μ).deviation i s s' ↔
    (∀ (j : I), j ≠ i → s' j = s j) ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun θ ↦ G.payoff i (G.measurableActionProfile s' θ) θ) μ
  -- hash 1fee1cc3b793203c

  [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
  (i : I) (s : G.Strategy) : V
  eq_1 {I : Type uI} {Θ : I → Type uT} {A : I → Type uA} {V : Type uV}
    [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)] [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
    (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i)) (i : I) (s : G.Strategy) :
    G.exAntePayoff μ i s =
      ∫ (θ : (i_1 : I) → Θ i_1), G.payoff i (G.measurableActionProfile s θ) θ ∂μ
  -- hash f2106fd86a8b7347

  {Θ : I → Type uT} {A : I → Type uA} {V : Type uV} [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)]
  [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ μ_1 : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
  (e_μ : μ = μ_1) (i i_1 : I) (e_i : i = i_1) (s s_1 : G.Strategy) (e_s : s = s_1) :
  G.exAntePayoff μ i s = G.exAntePayoff μ_1 i_1 s_1

  [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V] (i : I)
  (s : G.PureStrategy) : V
  eq_1 {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
    (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V] (i : I)
    (s : G.PureStrategy) :
    G.exAntePayoffFin d i s = d.expect fun θ ↦ G.payoff i (G.actionProfile s θ) θ

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.exAntePayoffFin_eq_exAntePayoff.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
  {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)]

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.exAntePayoffFin_eq_sum.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
  {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V] (i : I)
  (s : G.PureStrategy) :
  G.exAntePayoffFin d i s = ∑ t, d.marginalD i t • G.interimPayoffActionFin d i t (s i t) s
  -- hash 0546ce3c30ff5c4e

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.exAntePayoffFin_update.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
  {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V] (i : I)
  (s : G.PureStrategy) (f : Θ i → A i) :
  G.exAntePayoffFin d i (Function.update s i f) =
    ∑ t, d.marginalD i t • G.interimPayoffActionFin d i t (f t) s

  {I : Type uI} {Θ : I → Type uT} {A : I → Type uA} {B : I → Type uB} {V : Type uV}

  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))

    G.exAntePayoff μ i (MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.Strategy.mapActions G κ s)

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.expandedGame.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {I : Type u_1}
  {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V] [Fintype I]
  [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) :
  MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame ((i : I) × Θ i) (fun p ↦ A p.fst) V
  eq_1 {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V]
    [Module ℝ V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
    (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) :
    G.expandedGame d =
      { payoff := fun p s ↦ G.interimPayoffActionFin d p.fst p.snd (s p) (G.fromExpandedProfile s) }
  -- hash 25ef8c1b8649d099

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.interimPayoffAction.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {I : Type u_1}

  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
  (B : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianPrior.ConditionalBeliefs μ) [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] (i : I) (θᵢ : Θ i) (aᵢ : A i) (s : G.Strategy) : V
  eq_1 {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [DecidableEq I]
    [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]
    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
    (B : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianPrior.ConditionalBeliefs μ) [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] (i : I) (θᵢ : Θ i) (aᵢ : A i) (s : G.Strategy) :
    G.interimPayoffAction μ B i θᵢ aᵢ s =
      ∫ (θo : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianPrior.OpponentProfile Θ i),
        G.interimPayoffActionIntegrand i θᵢ aᵢ s θo ∂(B.opponents i) θᵢ
  -- hash eab26aa69fe4c94c

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.interimPayoffActionFin.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {I : Type u_1}
  {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V] [Fintype I]
  [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) (i : I) (θ_i : Θ i) (a_i : A i)
  (s : G.PureStrategy) : V
  eq_1 {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V]
    [Module ℝ V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
    (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) (i : I) (θ_i : Θ i) (a_i : A i)
    (s : G.PureStrategy) :
    G.interimPayoffActionFin d i θ_i a_i s =
      ∑ θ with θ i = θ_i,
        d.condProbD i θ_i θ • G.payoff i (Function.update (G.actionProfile s θ) i a_i) θ
  -- hash da6872ded2750c27

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.interimPayoffActionFin.congr_simp.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}
  {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V]
  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] {inst : (i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)}
  [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)] (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d d_1 : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) (e_d : d = d_1) (i : I)
  (θ_i θ_i_1 : Θ i) (e_θ_i : θ_i = θ_i_1) (a_i a_i_1 : A i) (e_a_i : a_i = a_i_1)
  (s s_1 : G.PureStrategy) (e_s : s = s_1) :

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.interimPayoffActionIntegrand.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4}

  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (i : I) (θᵢ : Θ i) (aᵢ : A i) (s : G.Strategy)

    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (i : I) (θᵢ : Θ i) (aᵢ : A i) (s : G.Strategy)
    (θo : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianPrior.OpponentProfile Θ i) :

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.interimPayoffFin.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {I : Type u_1}
  {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V] [Fintype I]
  [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) (i : I) (θ_i : Θ i) (s : G.PureStrategy) : V
  eq_1 {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V]
    [Module ℝ V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
    (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) (i : I) (θ_i : Θ i) (s : G.PureStrategy) :
    G.interimPayoffFin d i θ_i s =
      ∑ θ with θ i = θ_i, d.condProbD i θ_i θ • G.payoff i (G.actionProfile s θ) θ

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.isBNEFin_iff.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {I : Type u_1}
  {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V] [Fintype I]
  [DecidableEq I] [(i : I) → Fintype (Θ i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (Θ i)]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist ((i : I) → Θ i)) [Preorder V] (s : G.PureStrategy) :
  G.IsBNEFin d s ↔
    ∀ (i : I) (θ_i : Θ i),
      0 < d.marginalD i θ_i →
        ∀ (a_i : A i),
          G.interimPayoffActionFin d i θ_i (s i θ_i) s ≥ G.interimPayoffActionFin d i θ_i a_i s
  -- hash 9a895addfee81e84

  {I : Type u_1} {Θ : I → Type u_2} {A : I → Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)

  [PartialOrder V] [IsOrderedAddMonoid V] [PosSMulMono ℝ V] (s : G.PureStrategy) :
  G.IsBNEFin d s ↔
    ∀ (i : I) (f : Θ i → A i),
      G.exAntePayoffFin d i (Function.update s i f) ≤ G.exAntePayoffFin d i s

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame.isBNE_iff.{uI, uT, uA, uV} {I : Type uI}
  {Θ : I → Type uT} {A : I → Type uA} {V : Type uV} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
  [CompleteSpace V] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (Θ i)] [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)] [LE V]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ((i : I) → Θ i))
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : G.Strategy) :
  G.IsBNE μ s ↔
    (∀ (i : I) (s' : G.Strategy),
        (∀ (j : I), j ≠ i → s' j = s j) →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun θ ↦ G.payoff i (G.measurableActionProfile s' θ) θ) μ →
            G.exAntePayoff μ i s' ≤ G.exAntePayoff μ i s) ∧
      G.IncumbentPayoffsIntegrable μ s
  -- hash c13243aa41267625

  [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (B i)] (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.BayesianGame I Θ A V)

  {A : ι → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [LE V] (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame ι A V)

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.Strategy.le_def.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {ι : Type u_1}
  {A : ι → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [LE V] {G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame ι A V} {i : ι}
  {s s' : G.Strategy i} :
  s ≤ s' ↔
    ∀ (a a' : (i_1 : ι) → A i_1),
      a i = s → a' i = s' → (∀ (j : ι), j ≠ i → a j = a' j) → G.payoff i a ≤ G.payoff i a'
  -- hash a2d23afee5a4b81b

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.isFiniteMixedNash_iff.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {I : Type u_1}
  {A : I → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [(i : I) → Fintype (A i)] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

  (σ : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.FiniteMixedStrategy A) :
  G.IsFiniteMixedNash σ ↔
    ∀ (i : I) (τ : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist (A i)),

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.isMixedNash_iff.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {I : Type u_1}
  {A : I → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)] [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [LE V]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame I A V)
  (σ : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.MixedStrategy A) :
  G.IsMixedNash σ ↔
    G.MixedPayoffsIntegrable σ ∧
      ∀ (i : I) (τ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (A i)),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (G.payoff i)
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun j ↦ ↑(Function.update σ i τ j)) →
          G.mixedExtension.payoff i (Function.update σ i τ) ≤ G.mixedExtension.payoff i σ
  -- hash d613ca72b533b8c2

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.mixedExtension.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {I : Type u_1}
  {A : I → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)] [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] [Fintype I] (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame I A V) :
  MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame I (fun i ↦ MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (A i)) V
  eq_1 {I : Type u_1} {A : I → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] [Fintype I]
    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame I A V) :
    G.mixedExtension =
      {
        payoff := fun i σ ↦
          ∫ (a : (i_1 : I) → A i_1), G.payoff i a ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun j ↦ ↑(σ j) }
  -- hash a1df1d1269abd55e

def MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.mixedNashProblem.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {I : Type u_1}
  {A : I → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)] [NormedAddCommGroup V]
  [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame I A V) :
  MathEconLib.GameTheory.EquilibriumProblem (MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.MixedStrategy A) I
    V
  eq_1 {I : Type u_1} {A : I → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame I A V) :
    G.mixedNashProblem =
      {
        deviation := fun i σ σ' ↦
          (∃ τ, σ' = Function.update σ i τ) ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (G.payoff i) (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun j ↦ ↑(σ' j)),
        value := G.mixedExtension.payoff }
  -- hash 64d7e4a6540f1f93

theorem MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.mixedNashProblem_deviation_iff.{u_1, u_2, u_3}
  {I : Type u_1} {A : I → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]
  [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame I A V) (i : I)
  (σ σ' : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame.MixedStrategy A) :
  G.mixedNashProblem.deviation i σ σ' ↔
    (∃ τ, σ' = Function.update σ i τ) ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (G.payoff i) (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun j ↦ ↑(σ' j))
  -- hash 77dd15546d3bc913

  {I : Type u_1} {A : I → Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [(i : I) → MeasurableSpace (A i)]

  (G : MathEconLib.GameTheory.StrategicGame ι A V) :

theorem MathEconLib.InteriorRegimeProblem.interior_regime_quadratic
  (P : MathEconLib.InteriorRegimeProblem) [P.HasTypeDeviationIC] (v : ℝ) (hv : v ∈ P.typeInterval) :
  P.α_coeff * P.strategy v ^ 2 + P.K_param * P.strategy v =
    P.allPayBid v - P.K_param ^ 2 / (4 * P.α_coeff)
  -- hash 6b1d2b09048aeed9

  (P : MathEconLib.InteriorRegimeProblem) [P.HasTypeDeviationIC] (v : ℝ) (hv : v ∈ P.typeInterval)
  (h_bAP_nn : 0 ≤ P.allPayBid v) (h_strat_ge : -P.K_param / (2 * P.α_coeff) ≤ P.strategy v) :
  P.strategy v = MathEconLib.AllPurchase.strategyInterior P.α_coeff (-P.K_param) (P.allPayBid v)

structure MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction (Ω : Type) [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] (n : ℕ) : Type
  constructor MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.mk
  parent MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.toAuction : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n
  field rules : MathEconLib.Mechanism (Fin n) (fun x ↦ ℝ) (Fin n → ℝ)
  field outcome_measurable : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable fun bids ↦ self.rules.outcome bids i
  field θmin : Fin n → ℝ
  field θmax : Fin n → ℝ
  field θ : Fin n → Ω → ℝ
  field θ_measurable : ∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (self.θ i)
  field spec : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.AllPurchaseSpec self.rules fun o i ↦ o i
  field φ_bar : ℝ
  field α_coeff : ℝ
  field α_pos : 0 < self.α_coeff
  field φ_bar_pos : 0 < self.φ_bar
  field scarcity_is_linear : self.spec.φ = fun b ↦ self.φ_bar - self.α_coeff * b
  -- hash 21fd391fa4591997

def MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.K_linear {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) (β : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ
  eq_1 {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) (β : ℝ → ℝ) :
    A.K_linear β = A.spec.price - A.φ_bar + A.α_coeff * (↑n - 1) * A.meanPurchase β
  -- hash 9baf0983b9a59bb1

theorem MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.allPurchaseNetCost_eq {Ω : Type}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  [n.AtLeastTwo] (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) [A.HasIdenticalTypes] (β : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hβ_meas : Measurable β)
  (hβ_int :
    ∀ (j : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ β (A.θ j ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (i : Fin n) (b : ℝ) : A.allPurchaseNetCost A.spec β i b = A.α_coeff * b ^ 2 + A.K_linear β * b
  -- hash 0bb9b40ba69bb0b7

theorem MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.boundary_regime_strategy_auction {Ω : Type}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  [n.AtLeastTwo] (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) [A.HasIdenticalTypes] (β : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hβ_meas : Measurable β)
  (hβ_int :
    ∀ (j : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ β (A.θ j ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (i : Fin n) (hIC : (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).HasTypeDeviationIC)
  (hBR : (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).IsBoundaryRegime) (hK : 0 ≤ A.K_linear β) (v : ℝ)
  (hv : v ∈ (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).typeInterval)
  (h_bAP_nn : 0 ≤ (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).allPayBid v) (h_strat_nn : 0 ≤ β v) :
  β v =
    MathEconLib.AllPurchase.strategyBoundary A.α_coeff (A.K_linear β)
      ((A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).allPayBid v)
  -- hash 6f1dac2a1e08502c

def MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.bundledEditionWelfare {Ω : Type}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) (β : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : ℝ
  eq_1 {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) (β : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    A.bundledEditionWelfare β c =
      (A.φ_bar - c) * A.expectedAggregateBid β - A.α_coeff * A.expectedAggregateBidSq β
  -- hash 873d6534cdd8cd5e

theorem MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.bundledEditionWelfare_eq {Ω : Type}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) (β : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
  (hB_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (A.aggregateBid β) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hB2_int :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.aggregateBid β ω ^ 2) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume) :
  A.bundledEditionWelfare β c = A.expectedEditionValue A.spec β - c * A.expectedAggregateBid β
  -- hash 06cc794e05f8ffdc

theorem MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.bundling_revenue_gain_of_isBoundaryRegime {Ω : Type}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) [A.HasIdenticalTypes] [A.HasIndependentTypes]
  [A.HasBoundedTypes] [A.HasAtomlessTypes] (β : ℝ → ℝ) (hβ_meas : Measurable β)
  (hβ_mono : StrictMonoOn β (Set.Icc A.lowestType A.highestType))
  (hIC : ∀ (i : Fin n), (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).HasTypeDeviationIC)
  (hBR : ∀ (i : Fin n), (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).IsBoundaryRegime)
  (ht_int :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.rules.payment i fun j ↦ β (A.θ j ω))
        MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hedition_int :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.aggregateBid β ω * A.spec.φ (A.aggregateBid β ω))
      MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hallPayBid_int :
    ∀ (i : Fin n),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.allPayBid (A.θ i ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (c : ℝ) :
  A.bundledProfit A.spec β c - A.allPayBenchmarkProfit -
      A.editionsOnlyBenchmarkProfit A.spec c A.cournotQuantityLinear =
    A.expectedEditionValue A.spec β - c * A.expectedAggregateBid β -
      (A.spec.price - c) * A.cournotQuantityLinear
  -- hash d784dbed30791617

theorem MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.expectedEditionValue_linear {Ω : Type}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) (β : ℝ → ℝ)

theorem MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.expected_scarcity_linear {Ω : Type}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) [A.HasIdenticalTypes] (β : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hβ_meas : Measurable β)
  (hβ_int :
    ∀ (j : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ β (A.θ j ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (i : Fin n) (b : ℝ) :

    A.φ_bar - A.α_coeff * (b + ↑(n - 1) * A.meanPurchase β)

theorem MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.interior_regime_strategy_auction {Ω : Type}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
  [n.AtLeastTwo] (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) [A.HasIdenticalTypes] (β : ℝ → ℝ)

    ∀ (j : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ β (A.θ j ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (i : Fin n) (hIC : (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).HasTypeDeviationIC) (hK_neg : A.K_linear β < 0)
  (hU_eq :
    (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).U (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).lowestType =
      A.K_linear β ^ 2 / (4 * A.α_coeff))

  (h_bAP_nn : 0 ≤ (A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i).allPayBid v)
  (h_strat_ge : -A.K_linear β / (2 * A.α_coeff) ≤ β v) :

  {scarcity_is_linear : spec.φ = fun b ↦ φ_bar - α_coeff * b} {toAuction' : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n}
  {spec' : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.AllPurchaseSpec toAuction'.rules fun o i ↦ o i}
  {φ_bar' α_coeff' : ℝ} {α_pos' : 0 < α_coeff'} {φ_bar_pos' : 0 < φ_bar'}
  {scarcity_is_linear' : spec'.φ = fun b ↦ φ_bar' - α_coeff' * b}
  (eq :
    { toAuction := toAuction, spec := spec, φ_bar := φ_bar, α_coeff := α_coeff, α_pos := α_pos,
        φ_bar_pos := φ_bar_pos, scarcity_is_linear := scarcity_is_linear } =
      { toAuction := toAuction', spec := spec', φ_bar := φ_bar', α_coeff := α_coeff',
        α_pos := α_pos', φ_bar_pos := φ_bar_pos', scarcity_is_linear := scarcity_is_linear' })

theorem MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.mk.sizeOf_spec {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [SizeOf Ω]
  (toAuction : MathEconLib.Auction Ω n)
  (spec : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.AllPurchaseSpec toAuction.rules fun o i ↦ o i)
  (φ_bar α_coeff : ℝ) (α_pos : 0 < α_coeff) (φ_bar_pos : 0 < φ_bar)
  (scarcity_is_linear : spec.φ = fun b ↦ φ_bar - α_coeff * b) :
  SizeOf.sizeOf
      { toAuction := toAuction, spec := spec, φ_bar := φ_bar, α_coeff := α_coeff, α_pos := α_pos,
        φ_bar_pos := φ_bar_pos, scarcity_is_linear := scarcity_is_linear } =
    1 + SizeOf.sizeOf toAuction + SizeOf.sizeOf spec + SizeOf.sizeOf φ_bar + SizeOf.sizeOf α_coeff +
          SizeOf.sizeOf α_pos +
        SizeOf.sizeOf φ_bar_pos +
      SizeOf.sizeOf scarcity_is_linear
  -- hash 007350ca9def9502

      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ A.allPayBid (A.θ i ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume) :

def MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction.toQuadraticCostProblem {Ω : Type}

  (hβ_meas : Measurable β)
  (hβ_int :
    ∀ (j : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ β (A.θ j ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (i : Fin n) : MathEconLib.QuadraticCostProblem
  eq_1 {Ω : Type} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    [n.AtLeastTwo] (A : MathEconLib.LinearScarcityAuction Ω n) [A.HasIdenticalTypes] (β : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hβ_meas : Measurable β)
    (hβ_int :
      ∀ (j : Fin n),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω ↦ β (A.θ j ω)) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
    (i : Fin n) :
    A.toQuadraticCostProblem β hβ_meas hβ_int i =
      { toBidderProblem := A.toBidderProblem ⋯ β i, α_coeff := A.α_coeff, K_param := A.K_linear β,
        α_pos := ⋯, cost_eq := ⋯ }

structure MathEconLib.Matching.Market.{u, v, w} (B : Type u) (S : Type v) (X : Type w) :
  Type (max (max u v) w)
  constructor MathEconLib.Matching.Market.mk
  field buyer : X → B
  field seller : X → S
  field choiceB : B → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X
  field choiceS : S → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X
  field buyer_eq_of_mem : ∀ ⦃b : B⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (self.choiceB b) Y → self.buyer x = b
  field seller_eq_of_mem : ∀ ⦃s : S⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (self.choiceS s) Y → self.seller x = s
  -- hash c43e1a3577768ab6

def MathEconLib.Matching.Market.Blocks.{u, v, w} {B : Type u} {S : Type v} {X : Type w}
  (M : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X) (A Z : Set X) : Prop
  eq_1 {B : Type u} {S : Type v} {X : Type w} (M : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X)
    (A Z : Set X) :
    M.Blocks A Z =
      (Z.Nonempty ∧
        Disjoint Z A ∧
          (∀ (b : B), M.buyerSide b Z ⊆ (M.choiceB b) (A ∪ Z)) ∧
            ∀ (s : S), M.sellerSide s Z ⊆ (M.choiceS s) (A ∪ Z))
  -- hash c3f7cc2b50f584d6

def MathEconLib.Matching.Market.BuyerChosen.{u, v, w} {B : Type u} {S : Type v} {X : Type w}
  (M : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X) (Y Z : Set X) : Prop
  eq_1 {B : Type u} {S : Type v} {X : Type w} (M : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X)
    (Y Z : Set X) : M.BuyerChosen Y Z = ∀ (b : B), (M.choiceB b) (Y ∪ Z) = M.buyerSide b Y
  -- hash 5231ea66284951e0

def MathEconLib.Matching.Market.BuyersBilaterallySubstitutable.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {B : Type u_1}

  eq_1 {B : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {X : Type u_3} (M : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X) :

def MathEconLib.Matching.Market.IndRational.{u, v, w} {B : Type u} {S : Type v} {X : Type w}
  (M : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X) (A : Set X) : Prop

theorem MathEconLib.Matching.Market.blocks_singleton_iff.{u, v, w} {B : Type u} {S : Type v}
  {X : Type w} (M : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X) {A : Set X} {z : X} :
  M.Blocks A {z} ↔
    z ∉ A ∧
      z ∈ (M.choiceB (M.buyer z)) (Insert.insert z A) ∧
        z ∈ (M.choiceS (M.seller z)) (Insert.insert z A)

  (buyer_eq_of_mem : ∀ ⦃b : B⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceB b) Y → buyer x = b)
  (seller_eq_of_mem : ∀ ⦃s : S⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceS s) Y → seller x = s) :
  MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X

theorem MathEconLib.Matching.Market.mk.inj.{u, v, w} {B : Type u} {S : Type v} {X : Type w}
  {buyer : X → B} {seller : X → S} {choiceB : B → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X}
  {choiceS : S → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X}
  {buyer_eq_of_mem : ∀ ⦃b : B⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceB b) Y → buyer x = b}
  {seller_eq_of_mem : ∀ ⦃s : S⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceS s) Y → seller x = s}
  {buyer_1 : X → B} {seller_1 : X → S} {choiceB_1 : B → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X}
  {choiceS_1 : S → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X}
  {buyer_eq_of_mem_1 : ∀ ⦃b : B⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceB_1 b) Y → buyer_1 x = b}
  {seller_eq_of_mem_1 : ∀ ⦃s : S⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceS_1 s) Y → seller_1 x = s}
  (x :
    { buyer := buyer, seller := seller, choiceB := choiceB, choiceS := choiceS,
        buyer_eq_of_mem := buyer_eq_of_mem, seller_eq_of_mem := seller_eq_of_mem } =
      { buyer := buyer_1, seller := seller_1, choiceB := choiceB_1, choiceS := choiceS_1,
        buyer_eq_of_mem := buyer_eq_of_mem_1, seller_eq_of_mem := seller_eq_of_mem_1 }) :

theorem MathEconLib.Matching.Market.mk.injEq.{u, v, w} {B : Type u} {S : Type v} {X : Type w}
  (buyer : X → B) (seller : X → S) (choiceB : B → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X)
  (choiceS : S → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X)
  (buyer_eq_of_mem : ∀ ⦃b : B⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceB b) Y → buyer x = b)
  (seller_eq_of_mem : ∀ ⦃s : S⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceS s) Y → seller x = s)
  (buyer_1 : X → B) (seller_1 : X → S) (choiceB_1 : B → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X)
  (choiceS_1 : S → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X)
  (buyer_eq_of_mem_1 : ∀ ⦃b : B⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceB_1 b) Y → buyer_1 x = b)

        buyer_eq_of_mem := buyer_eq_of_mem, seller_eq_of_mem := seller_eq_of_mem } =

        buyer_eq_of_mem := buyer_eq_of_mem_1, seller_eq_of_mem := seller_eq_of_mem_1 }) =
    (buyer = buyer_1 ∧ seller = seller_1 ∧ choiceB = choiceB_1 ∧ choiceS = choiceS_1)

def MathEconLib.Matching.Market.ofSellerPreferences.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {B : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2}
  {X : Type u_3} (buyer : X → B) (seller : X → S)
  (choiceB : B → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X)
  (hB : ∀ ⦃b : B⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceB b) Y → buyer x = b)
  (pref : (s : S) → LinearOrder (Option { x // seller x = s })) : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X
  eq_1 {B : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {X : Type u_3} (buyer : X → B) (seller : X → S)
    (choiceB : B → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X)
    (hB : ∀ ⦃b : B⦄ ⦃Y : Set X⦄ ⦃x : X⦄, x ∈ (choiceB b) Y → buyer x = b)
    (pref : (s : S) → LinearOrder (Option { x // seller x = s })) :
    MathEconLib.Matching.Market.ofSellerPreferences buyer seller choiceB hB pref =
      { buyer := buyer, seller := seller, choiceB := choiceB,
        choiceS := fun s ↦
          (MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction.ofOptionLinearOrder (pref s)).map
            (Function.Embedding.subtype fun x ↦ seller x = s),
        buyer_eq_of_mem := hB, seller_eq_of_mem := ⋯ }
  -- hash 4af956d626d891eb

def MathEconLib.Matching.Market.withBuyerCompletions.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {B : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2}
  {X : Type u_3} (M : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X)
  (D : B → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X)
  (hcomp : ∀ (b : B), MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction.IsCompletionOf M.seller (M.choiceB b) (D b))
  (hsub : ∀ (b : B), (D b).Substitutable) : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X
  eq_1 {B : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {X : Type u_3} (M : MathEconLib.Matching.Market B S X)
    (D : B → MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction X)
    (hcomp :
      ∀ (b : B), MathEconLib.Choice.ChoiceFunction.IsCompletionOf M.seller (M.choiceB b) (D b))
    (hsub : ∀ (b : B), (D b).Substitutable) :
    M.withBuyerCompletions D hcomp hsub =
      { buyer := M.buyer, seller := M.seller, choiceB := D, choiceS := M.choiceS,
        buyer_eq_of_mem := ⋯, seller_eq_of_mem := ⋯ }
  -- hash cadf7c10c5419ac9

  (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) [Fintype W] {m : M} {w : W} {Y : Set (M × W)} :
  mkt.bestM m Y = Option.some w ↔
    (m, w) ∈ Y ∧
      mkt.leM m Option.none (Option.some w) ∧
        ∀ (w' : W), (m, w') ∈ Y → mkt.leM m (Option.some w') (Option.some w)
  -- hash 605a1c8f1f6f11a3

def MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket.galeShapleyComputable.{u, v} {M : Type u} {W : Type v}
  (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) [Fintype M] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq M]
  [DecidableEq W] : M ≃. W
  eq_1 {M : Type u} {W : Type v} (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) [Fintype M]
    [Fintype W] [DecidableEq M] [DecidableEq W] :
    mkt.galeShapleyComputable =
      {
        toFun := fun m ↦
          mkt.bestMFinset m (Finset.univ \ mkt.gsRejectedFinset (Fintype.card (M × W))),
        invFun := fun w ↦
          mkt.bestWFinset w (mkt.gsProposalsFinset (mkt.gsRejectedFinset (Fintype.card (M × W)))),
        inv := ⋯ }

  (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) [Fintype M] [Fintype W] (R : Set (M × W)) :
  Set (M × W)

    [Fintype W] (R : Set (M × W)) :
    mkt.gsHeld R = {p | p ∈ mkt.gsProposals R ∧ Option.some p.1 = mkt.bestW p.2 (mkt.gsProposals R)}
  -- hash 1748b0c60468f6c5

def MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket.gsMatchingAt.{u, v} {M : Type u} {W : Type v}

  (hR : Function.IsFixedPt mkt.gsStep R) : M ≃. W

  {W : Type v} (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) [Fintype M] [Fintype W] (n : ℕ)

    p ∈
      (mkt.toContractsMarket.choiceB (mkt.toContractsMarket.buyer p))

      (mkt.toContractsMarket.choiceS (mkt.toContractsMarket.seller p))
        (Insert.insert p (mkt.graphOf (mkt.gsMatchingAt (mkt.gsRejected n) hn)))) :

  -- hash f24e65fd06ee1ede

theorem MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket.mem_inducedChoiceM_iff.{u, v} {M : Type u} {W : Type v}
  (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) {m : M} {w : W} {Y : Set (M × W)} :
  (m, w) ∈ (mkt.inducedChoiceM m) Y ↔
    (m, w) ∈ Y ∧
      mkt.leM m Option.none (Option.some w) ∧
        ∀ (w' : W), (m, w') ∈ Y → mkt.leM m (Option.some w') (Option.some w)
  -- hash 01d0ffb7c7233221

  (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) [Fintype M] {w : W} {p : M × W}
  {Y : Set (M × W)} : p ∈ (mkt.inducedChoiceW w) Y ↔ p.2 = w ∧ Option.some p.1 = mkt.bestW w Y
  -- hash 786d0b57ff514fd8

  (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) {m : M} {w : W} {Y : Set (M × W)} :

  (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) : MathEconLib.Matching.Market W M (M × W)
  eq_1 {M : Type u} {W : Type v} (mkt : MathEconLib.Matching.MarriageMarket M W) :

def MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.IsUnitIntervalAllocation.{u, v, w} {I : Type u} {A : I → Type v}
  {O : Type w} (M : MathEconLib.Mechanism I A O) (alloc : O → I → ℝ) : Prop
  eq_1 {I : Type u} {A : I → Type v} {O : Type w} (M : MathEconLib.Mechanism I A O)
    (alloc : O → I → ℝ) :
    MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.IsUnitIntervalAllocation M alloc =
      ∀ (i : I) (b : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Profile A), alloc (M.outcome b) i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1
  -- hash ebe5f6530ba98953

def MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.UsesStrictHighestBidAllocation.{u, w} {I : Type u} {O : Type w}
  (M : MathEconLib.Mechanism I (fun x ↦ ℝ) O) (alloc : O → I → ℝ) : Prop
  eq_1 {I : Type u} {O : Type w} (M : MathEconLib.Mechanism I (fun x ↦ ℝ) O) (alloc : O → I → ℝ) :
    MathEconLib.Mechanism.Auctions.UsesStrictHighestBidAllocation M alloc =
      ∀ (i : I), (fun b ↦ alloc (M.outcome b) i) = {b | ∀ (j : I), j ≠ i → b j < b i}.indicator 1
  -- hash 6607fb4bb0ec7912

  {O : Type uO} (E : MathEconLib.Mechanism.QuasilinearEnvironment I T O)
  (M : MathEconLib.Mechanism.DirectMechanism I T O) [DecidableEq I] : Prop
  eq_1 {I : Type uI} {T : I → Type uT} {O : Type uO}
    (E : MathEconLib.Mechanism.QuasilinearEnvironment I T O)
    (M : MathEconLib.Mechanism.DirectMechanism I T O) [DecidableEq I] :
    MathEconLib.Mechanism.DirectMechanism.IsDSIC E M =
      ∀ (i : I) (θ r : MathEconLib.Mechanism.Profile T),
        E.utility M i θ r ≤ E.utility M i θ (Function.update r i (θ i))

def MathEconLib.Mechanism.comap.{uI, uA, uB, uO} {I : Type uI} {A : I → Type uA} {B : I → Type uB}
  {O : Type uO} (M : MathEconLib.Mechanism I A O) (σ : (i : I) → B i → A i) :
  MathEconLib.Mechanism I B O
  eq_1 {I : Type uI} {A : I → Type uA} {B : I → Type uB} {O : Type uO}
    (M : MathEconLib.Mechanism I A O) (σ : (i : I) → B i → A i) :
    M.comap σ =
      { outcome := fun b ↦ M.outcome fun i ↦ σ i (b i),
        transfer := fun i b ↦ M.transfer i fun j ↦ σ j (b j) }
  -- hash fc159cc690617473

  (σ : (i : I) → B i → A i) (τ : (i : I) → C i → B i) :
  (M.comap σ).comap τ = M.comap fun i ↦ σ i ∘ τ i

theorem MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup.cdf_val.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (S : MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup Ω n) (i₀ k : Fin n) (x : ℝ) :
  ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.val k) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
      x =
    ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc (↑k + 1) n,
      ↑(n.choose l) *
          ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
              x ^
            l *
        (1 -
            ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
              x) ^
          (n - l)
  -- hash f25567c2d650cba9

theorem MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup.expected_second_highest.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (S : MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup Ω n) [n.AtLeastTwo] (i₀ : Fin n) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
  (bounded : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω), S.X i ω ∈ Set.Icc a b)
  (F_a :
    ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
        a =
      0)
  (F_b :
    ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
        b =
      1) :
  ∫ (a_1 : Ω), S.val ⟨n - 2, ⋯⟩ a_1 =
    ↑n *
      ∫ (ω : Ω),
        S.X i₀ ω *
            ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
                (S.X i₀ ω) ^
              (n - 1) -
          ∫ (ψ : ℝ) in a..S.X i₀ ω,
            ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
                ψ ^
              (n - 1)
  -- hash effad24c0a6667ce

theorem MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup.expected_val.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (S : MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup Ω n) (k i₀ : Fin n) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
  (hF_a :
    ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
        a =
      0)
  (hF_b :
    ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
        b =
      1) :
  ∫ (a_1 : Ω), S.val k a_1 =
    ↑n.factorial / (↑(↑k).factorial * ↑(n - 1 - ↑k).factorial) *
      ∫ (ψ : ℝ) in a..b,
        ψ *
              ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                      (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
                  ψ ^
                ↑k *
            (1 -
                ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                      (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
                  ψ) ^
              (n - 1 - ↑k) *
          (MeasureTheory.pdf (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume
              MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume ψ).toReal
  -- hash 419d0fe580455eae

  -- hash c4cc0f55f231af35

theorem MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup.hasDerivAt_binomial_tail_sum {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) (p : ℝ) :

    (↑n.factorial / (↑(↑k).factorial * ↑(n - 1 - ↑k).factorial) * p ^ ↑k * (1 - p) ^ (n - 1 - ↑k)) p
  -- hash 0845e9740264c36f

theorem MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup.identDistrib_val.{u_2, u_3} {n : ℕ} {Ω₁ : Type u_2}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω₁]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {Ω₂ : Type u_3}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω₂]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume]
  (S₁ : MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup Ω₁ n) (S₂ : MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup Ω₂ n)
  (hident :
    ∀ (i j : Fin n),
      ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (S₁.X i) (S₂.X j) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume

theorem MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup.pdf_val.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (S : MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup Ω n) (i₀ k : Fin n) :
  MeasureTheory.pdf (S.val k) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume
      MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume]
    fun x ↦
    ENNReal.ofReal
        (↑n.factorial / (↑(↑k).factorial * ↑(n - 1 - ↑k).factorial) *
            ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
                x ^
              ↑k *
          (1 -
              ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
                x) ^
            (n - 1 - ↑k)) *
      MeasureTheory.pdf (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume
        x
  -- hash 826d95bbbbcde261

theorem MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup.prob_count_eq.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (S : MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup Ω n) (i₀ : Fin n) (l : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
  MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.real {ω | {x_1 | S.X x_1 ω ≤ x}.card = l} =
    ↑(n.choose l) *
        ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
            x ^
          l *
      (1 -
          ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
            x) ^
        (n - l)
  -- hash 5433dd79102a4668

theorem MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup.prob_iInter_inter_iInter_eq.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  [MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace Ω]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] {n : ℕ}
  (S : MathEconLib.OrderStatisticsSetup Ω n) (i₀ : Fin n) (T : Finset (Fin n)) (x : ℝ) :
  MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.real
      ((⋂ i ∈ T, {ω | S.X i ω ≤ x}) ∩ ⋂ i, ⋂ (_ : i ∉ T), {ω | ¬S.X i ω ≤ x}) =
    ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
          x ^
        T.card *
      (1 -
          ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (S.X i₀) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume))
            x) ^
        (n - T.card)
  -- hash 913d5a2e35dd1002

def MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist.condProb.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [Fintype α]
  (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist α) (e : Set α) [DecidablePred fun x ↦ x ∈ e] (x : α) : ℝ
  eq_1 {α : Type u_1} [Fintype α] (d : MathEconLib.Probability.FinDist α) (e : Set α)
    [DecidablePred fun x ↦ x ∈ e] (x : α) :
    d.condProb e x = if x ∈ e ∧ 0 < d.probEvent e then d x / d.probEvent e else 0
  -- hash 2fb764cd1f2ec0c4

def MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.postedPriceProblem (lowestType highestType price : ℝ) :
  MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.PurchaseDecision
  eq_1 (lowestType highestType price : ℝ) :
    MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.postedPriceProblem lowestType highestType price =
      { lowestType := lowestType, highestType := highestType,
        allocation := MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.PurchaseDecision.allocation,
        allocation_range := ⋯,
        payment := MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.PurchaseDecision.payment price,
        strategy := fun v ↦
          if price ≤ v then MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.PurchaseDecision.buy
          else MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.PurchaseDecision.doNotBuy }
  -- hash f84f4895367dd823

theorem MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.expectedPayment_eq_integral_q_mul_sub_one_sub_cdf.{u}
  {Action : Type u} (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution)
  (P : MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem Action) [P.HasEnvelopeIC] (density : ℝ → ℝ)
  (horder : P.lowestType ≤ P.highestType)
  (hsupport : D.IsSupportedOnInterval P.lowestType P.highestType)
  (hD : (↑D).AbsolutelyContinuous MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)

  D.expectedPayment P =
    (∫ (value : ℝ) in P.lowestType..P.highestType,
        P.q value * (value * density value - (1 - ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf ↑D) value))) -
      P.U P.lowestType

def MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.sellerProfit.{u} {Action : Type u}
  (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution) (P : MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem Action)
  (continuationValue acquisitionCost : ℝ) : ℝ
  eq_1 {Action : Type u} (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution)
    (P : MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem Action) (continuationValue acquisitionCost : ℝ) :
    D.sellerProfit P continuationValue acquisitionCost =
      continuationValue - acquisitionCost + D.expectedPayment P -
        continuationValue * D.expectedAllocation P
  -- hash 9b9aa0df2a549242

theorem MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.sellerProfit_eq_virtualSurplus.{u} {Action : Type u}
  (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution) (P : MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem Action)
  [P.HasEnvelopeIC] (density : ℝ → ℝ) (continuationValue acquisitionCost : ℝ)
  (horder : P.lowestType ≤ P.highestType)
  (hsupport : D.IsSupportedOnInterval P.lowestType P.highestType)
  (hD : (↑D).AbsolutelyContinuous MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hdensity : density =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.restrict P.typeInterval] D.realDensity) :
  D.sellerProfit P continuationValue acquisitionCost =
    continuationValue - acquisitionCost - P.U P.lowestType +
      ∫ (value : ℝ) in P.lowestType..P.highestType,
        P.q value * (D.virtualSurplusWeight density value - continuationValue * density value)
  -- hash e6744fce2fcc16a5

theorem MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.sellerProfit_eq_virtualSurplus_cdf.{u} {Action : Type u}
  (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution) (P : MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem Action)
  [P.HasEnvelopeIC] (density : ℝ → ℝ) (continuationValue acquisitionCost : ℝ)
  (horder : P.lowestType ≤ P.highestType)
  (hsupport : D.IsSupportedOnInterval P.lowestType P.highestType)
  (hD : (↑D).AbsolutelyContinuous MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hdensity : density =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.restrict P.typeInterval] D.realDensity) :
  D.sellerProfit P continuationValue acquisitionCost =
    continuationValue - acquisitionCost - P.U P.lowestType +
      ∫ (value : ℝ) in P.lowestType..P.highestType,
        P.q value *
          (value * density value - (1 - ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf ↑D) value) -
            continuationValue * density value)
  -- hash 59731b885b52268e

theorem MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.sellerProfit_eq_virtualSurplus_realDensity.{u}
  {Action : Type u} (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution)
  (P : MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem Action) [P.HasEnvelopeIC]
  (continuationValue acquisitionCost : ℝ) (horder : P.lowestType ≤ P.highestType)
  (hsupport : D.IsSupportedOnInterval P.lowestType P.highestType)
  (hD : (↑D).AbsolutelyContinuous MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume) :
  D.sellerProfit P continuationValue acquisitionCost =
    continuationValue - acquisitionCost - P.U P.lowestType +
      ∫ (value : ℝ) in P.lowestType..P.highestType,
        P.q value *
          (D.virtualSurplusWeight D.realDensity value - continuationValue * D.realDensity value)
  -- hash 493a5c13e5eb35ed

theorem MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.sellerProfit_postedPriceProblem
  (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution)
  (lowestType highestType price continuationValue acquisitionCost : ℝ) :
  D.sellerProfit
      (MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.postedPriceProblem lowestType highestType price)
      continuationValue acquisitionCost =
    continuationValue - acquisitionCost + (price - continuationValue) * D.probAtLeast price
  -- hash da9378fcd66c5f41

theorem MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.sellerProfit_postedPriceProblem_eq_intervalIntegral_netVirtualSurplus
  (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution) (lowestType highestType price : ℝ) (density : ℝ → ℝ)
  (continuationValue acquisitionCost : ℝ) (hprice : price ∈ Set.Icc lowestType highestType)
  (hsupport : D.IsSupportedOnInterval lowestType highestType)
  (hD : (↑D).AbsolutelyContinuous MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume)
  (hdensity :
    density =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.restrict (Set.Icc lowestType highestType)]
      D.realDensity) :
  D.sellerProfit
      (MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.postedPriceProblem lowestType highestType price)
      continuationValue acquisitionCost =
    continuationValue - acquisitionCost +
      ∫ (value : ℝ) in price..highestType,
        D.virtualSurplusWeight density value - continuationValue * density value
  -- hash 6e28d4c2a246ddd5

theorem MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.sellerProfit_postedPriceProblem_sub
  (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution)
  (lowestType highestType price₁ price₂ continuationValue acquisitionCost : ℝ) :
  D.sellerProfit
        (MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.postedPriceProblem lowestType highestType price₁)
        continuationValue acquisitionCost -
      D.sellerProfit
        (MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.postedPriceProblem lowestType highestType price₂)
        continuationValue acquisitionCost =
    (price₁ - continuationValue) * D.probAtLeast price₁ -
      (price₂ - continuationValue) * D.probAtLeast price₂
  -- hash 69ea6f50832eb33d

theorem MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.sellerProfit_postedPriceProblem_zero
  (D : MathEconLib.ValueDistribution) (lowestType highestType price : ℝ) :
  D.sellerProfit
      (MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.postedPriceProblem lowestType highestType price) 0 0 =
    price * D.probAtLeast price
  -- hash d2081c3914149fca

theorem MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.sellerProfit_uniformInterval (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
  (price continuationValue acquisitionCost : ℝ) (hprice : price ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
  (MathEconLib.ValueDistribution.uniformInterval a b hab).sellerProfit
      (MathEconLib.SingleParameterProblem.postedPriceProblem a b price) continuationValue
      acquisitionCost =
    continuationValue - acquisitionCost + (price - continuationValue) * ((b - price) / (b - a))

theorem MeasurableEquiv.map_trans.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3}
  [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSpace γ] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α}
  (e : α ≃ᵐ β) (e' : β ≃ᵐ γ) :
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map (⇑(e.trans e')) μ =
    MeasureTheory.Measure.map (⇑e') (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (⇑e) μ)
  -- hash 2d63887afa94fc39

def MeasurableEquiv.piSplitAt.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (α : ι → Type u_2)
  [(i_1 : ι) → MeasurableSpace (α i_1)] : ((i_1 : ι) → α i_1) ≃ᵐ α i × ((j : { j // j ≠ i }) → α ↑j)
  eq_1 {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (α : ι → Type u_2)
    [(i_1 : ι) → MeasurableSpace (α i_1)] :
    MeasurableEquiv.piSplitAt i α =
      { toEquiv := Equiv.piSplitAt i α, measurable_toFun := ⋯, measurable_invFun := ⋯ }
  -- hash 86a5faf4f18d32cc

  (α : ι → Type u_2) [(i_1 : ι) → MeasurableSpace (α i_1)] (f : (j : ι) → α j) :
  (MeasurableEquiv.piSplitAt i α) f = (f i, fun j ↦ f ↑j)

theorem MeasurableEquiv.piSplitAt_eq_piCongrLeft_trans_piOptionEquivProd.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1}
  [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (α : ι → Type u_2) [(i_1 : ι) → MeasurableSpace (α i_1)] :
  MeasurableEquiv.piSplitAt i α =
    (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft α (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i)).symm.trans
      ((MeasurableEquiv.piOptionEquivProd fun b ↦ α ((Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i) b)).trans
        MeasurableEquiv.prodComm)

  eq_1 {α : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace α] [DiscreteMeasurableSpace α] [Fintype α] :
    MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.equivStdSimplex =
      { toFun := fun μ ↦ ⟨fun a ↦ ↑(μ {a}), ⋯⟩,

  -- hash c51c39de6a9bccf5

def MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix (K : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) (a : ℕ) : List ℕ
  eq_1 (K : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) : MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K 0 = []
  eq_2 (K : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) (n : ℕ) :
    MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K n.succ =
      MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K n ++
        [InfSet.sInf
            {m |
              (K ∩ MeasureTheory.listCylinder (MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K n ++ [m])).Nonempty}]
  -- hash f85ea7eb4d7a1f7d

theorem MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix.eq_def (K : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) (x : ℕ) :
  MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K x =
    match x with
    | 0 => []
    | n.succ =>
      have t := MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K n;
      t ++ [InfSet.sInf {m | (K ∩ MeasureTheory.listCylinder (t ++ [m])).Nonempty}]
  -- hash 830facb4f66977b3

  (MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K n).length = n

  MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K m <+: MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K n
  -- hash edba1bc5906d76b7

theorem MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix_succ_eq_append_iff {K : Set (ℕ → ℕ)} (hne : K.Nonempty) {n : ℕ}
  {t : List ℕ} (ht : t.length = n) {m : ℕ} :
  MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K (n + 1) = t ++ [m] ↔
    MeasureTheory.leftmostPrefix K n = t ∧
      (K ∩ MeasureTheory.listCylinder (t ++ [m])).Nonempty ∧
        ∀ j < m, K ∩ MeasureTheory.listCylinder (t ++ [j]) = ∅
  -- hash 429ae507d22e1fdb

  (hright : ∀ (a : α), {b | r a b}.Subsingleton) (hleft : ∀ (b : β), {a | r a b}.Subsingleton) :
  α ≃. β
  eq_1 {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (r : α → β → Prop) (hright : ∀ (a : α), {b | r a b}.Subsingleton)
    (hleft : ∀ (b : β), {a | r a b}.Subsingleton) :
    PEquiv.ofRelation r hright hleft =
      { toFun := PEquiv.relationValue r, invFun := PEquiv.relationValue fun b a ↦ r a b, inv := ⋯ }
  -- hash 5aac474a7360028c

theorem PEquiv.ofRelation_apply_eq_some_iff.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (r : α → β → Prop)
  (hright : ∀ (a : α), {b | r a b}.Subsingleton) (hleft : ∀ (b : β), {a | r a b}.Subsingleton)
  {a : α} {b : β} : (PEquiv.ofRelation r hright hleft) a = Option.some b ↔ r a b
  -- hash d77ef674113eee48

theorem PEquiv.ofRelation_graph.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (μ : α ≃. β) :
  PEquiv.ofRelation (fun a b ↦ (a, b) ∈ μ.graph) ⋯ ⋯ = μ
  -- hash 41050904914fff74

def PEquiv.relationValue.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (r : α → β → Prop) (a : α) : Option β
  eq_1 {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (r : α → β → Prop) (a : α) :
    PEquiv.relationValue r a =
      if h : ∃ b, r a b then Option.some (Classical.choose h) else Option.none
  -- hash c0799706dd499bb3

  {b : β} (hsub : {b_1 | r a b_1}.Subsingleton) : PEquiv.relationValue r a = Option.some b ↔ r a b

theorem UpperHemicontinuous.exists_isApproxSelection.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} [UniformSpace X]
  [ParacompactSpace X] [T2Space X] {E : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace E]
  [IsTopologicalAddGroup E] [ContinuousSMul ℝ E] {F : X → Set E} (hF : UpperHemicontinuous F)
  (hF' : ∀ (x : X), (F x).Nonempty) (hF'' : ∀ (x : X), Convex ℝ (F x)) {U : Set (X × X)}
  (hU : U ∈ uniformity X) {W : Set E} (hW : IsOpen W) (hW' : 0 ∈ W) (hW'' : Convex ℝ W) {s : Set E}
  (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hFs : ∀ (x : X), F x ⊆ s) :
  ∃ f, Continuous f ∧ Set.range f ⊆ s ∧ IsApproxSelection F U W f
  -- hash 430be0d99b7111b7

  [ParacompactSpace X] [T2Space X] {E : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace E]
  [IsTopologicalAddGroup E] [ContinuousSMul ℝ E] [LocallyConvexSpace ℝ E] {F : X → Set E}
  (hF : UpperHemicontinuous F) (hF' : ∀ (x : X), (F x).Nonempty) (hF'' : ∀ (x : X), Convex ℝ (F x))
  {U : Set (X × X)} (hU : U ∈ uniformity X) {W : Set E} (hW : W ∈ nhds 0) {s : Set E}
  (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hFs : ∀ (x : X), F x ⊆ s) :
  ∃ f, Continuous f ∧ Set.range f ⊆ s ∧ IsApproxSelection F U W f
  -- hash d5534ad1c6283f3a

theorem UpperHemicontinuous.exists_isApproxSelection_metric.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1}
  [MetricSpace X] {E : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {F : X → Set E}
  (hF : UpperHemicontinuous F) (hF' : ∀ (x : X), (F x).Nonempty) (hF'' : ∀ (x : X), Convex ℝ (F x))
  {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {s : Set E} (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hFs : ∀ (x : X), F x ⊆ s) :
  ∃ f,
    Continuous f ∧
      Set.range f ⊆ s ∧ ∀ (x : X), ∃ x', Dist.dist x x' < ε ∧ Metric.infDist (f x) (F x') < ε
  -- hash 0426e85b0ae27d0b

theorem exists_star_refinement.{u, v} {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [ParacompactSpace X]
  [T2Space X] {ι : Type v} (C : ι → Set X) (hC_open : ∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (C i))
  (hC_cover : ⋃ i, C i = Set.univ) :
  ∃ κ S π,
    (∀ (k : κ), IsOpen (S k)) ∧
      ⋃ k, S k = Set.univ ∧
        LocallyFinite S ∧
          (∀ (k : κ), S k ⊆ C (π k)) ∧ ∀ (k₁ k₂ : κ), (S k₁ ∩ S k₂).Nonempty → S k₁ ⊆ C (π k₂)
  -- hash e6452306c3387479

theorem integral_mul_integral_le_of_likelihoodRatioLE {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ}
  [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] {p q g : ℝ → ℝ} (hlr : LikelihoodRatioLE p q) (hg : Monotone g)
  (hpi : MeasureTheory.Integrable p μ) (hqi : MeasureTheory.Integrable q μ)
  (hgpi : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x ↦ g x * p x) μ)
  (hgqi : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x ↦ g x * q x) μ) :
  (∫ (x : ℝ), g x * p x ∂μ) * ∫ (x : ℝ), q x ∂μ ≤ (∫ (x : ℝ), g x * q x ∂μ) * ∫ (x : ℝ), p x ∂μ
  -- hash 45773b6e362d9403

theorem integral_mul_le_of_likelihoodRatioLE {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ}
  [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] {p q g : ℝ → ℝ} (hlr : LikelihoodRatioLE p q) (hg : Monotone g)
  (hpi : MeasureTheory.Integrable p μ) (hqi : MeasureTheory.Integrable q μ)
  (hgpi : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x ↦ g x * p x) μ)
  (hgqi : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x ↦ g x * q x) μ) (hp1 : ∫ (x : ℝ), p x ∂μ = 1)
  (hq1 : ∫ (x : ℝ), q x ∂μ = 1) : ∫ (x : ℝ), g x * p x ∂μ ≤ ∫ (x : ℝ), g x * q x ∂μ
  -- hash 4bdcec0865ada942

theorem isApproxSelection_metric_iff.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
  [SeminormedAddCommGroup Y] (F : X → Set Y) (ε : ℝ) (f : X → Y) :
  IsApproxSelection F {p | Dist.dist p.1 p.2 < ε} (Metric.ball 0 ε) f ↔
    ∀ (x : X), ∃ x', Dist.dist x x' < ε ∧ f x ∈ F x' + Metric.ball 0 ε
  -- hash 4da1064575b6ab53

  [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] {p q : ℝ → ℝ} (hlr : LikelihoodRatioLE p q)
  (hpi : MeasureTheory.Integrable p μ) (hqi : MeasureTheory.Integrable q μ) (t : ℝ) :
  (∫ (x : ℝ) in Set.Ioi t, p x ∂μ) * ∫ (x : ℝ), q x ∂μ ≤
    (∫ (x : ℝ) in Set.Ioi t, q x ∂μ) * ∫ (x : ℝ), p x ∂μ
